items_flat.title_en: NVIDIA Deepens Korea AI Ecosystem with SK Group $500B+ Factories, NAVER Expansion and SNU AI Technology Center
items_flat.title_zh: NVIDIA深化韓國AI生態：SK集團逾5000億美元工廠、NAVER擴建與首爾大學AI技術中心
items_flat.summary_en: NVIDIA announced a $500-billion-plus partnership with SK Group spanning AI factories and next-generation memory, including a 2-gigawatt NVIDIA Vera Rubin DSX AI Factory to be built by SK Telecom (powered by SK hynix HBM, targeted 2027) plus NAVER and Brookfield expansion of Korea’s sovereign AI factory capacity. Later the same day NVIDIA introduced the NVIDIA AI Technology Center at Seoul National University for joint research in physical AI, accelerated computing and talent development.
items_flat.summary_zh: NVIDIA宣布與SK集團超過5000億美元的合作，涵蓋AI工廠與次世代記憶體，包括SK Telecom將建造的2吉瓦NVIDIA Vera Rubin DSX AI工廠（採用SK hynix HBM，目標2027年），以及NAVER與Brookfield擴建韓國主權AI工廠。同日稍晚NVIDIA宣布於首爾大學設立NVIDIA AI技術中心，聚焦實體AI、加速運算與人才培育的聯合研究。
items_flat.analysis_en: These coordinated deals highlight intensifying sovereign AI infrastructure competition in Asia and NVIDIA’s full-stack lock-in strategy across compute, memory and talent. Execution risk remains high given the multi-year scale and power requirements.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這些協調式交易凸顯亞洲主權AI基礎建設競爭加劇，以及NVIDIA在運算、記憶體與人才上的全棧鎖定策略。多年期規模與電力需求仍帶來執行風險。
items_flat.quote: Korea isn't just an NVIDIA partner anymore. It's where the next wave of AI gets built and SNU is at the center of it. Introducing the NVIDIA AI Technology Center at @SeoulNatlUni.
items_flat.quote_zh: 韓國不再只是NVIDIA的合作夥伴。這裡是下一波AI建造的地方，首爾大學位居中心。宣布於首爾大學設立NVIDIA AI技術中心。

items_flat.title_en: Demis Hassabis Affirms Support for Strong Open AI Ecosystem
items_flat.title_zh: Demis Hassabis重申支持強大開放AI生態系
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind CEO Demis Hassabis posted on X that a strong and secure open ecosystem is important for the world to benefit from AI. He highlighted DeepMind’s contributions including Jax, Transformers, AlphaFold and Gemma models (Gemma 4 models 300M+ downloads; overall Gemma series 900M+). The post responded to NVIDIA’s open-weights letter.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind執行長Demis Hassabis在X發文表示，強大且安全的開放生態系對世界從AI獲益至關重要。他強調DeepMind的貢獻包括Jax、Transformers、AlphaFold與Gemma模型（Gemma 4下載逾3億次；Gemma系列整體逾9億次）。此文回應NVIDIA的開放權重公開信。
items_flat.analysis_en: This restates Google’s consistent open-source posture amid the open-versus-closed policy debate. Uncertainty remains on how regulators will weigh open-model contributions against potential misuse risks from frontier open weights.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此舉重申Google一貫的開源立場，正值開放與封閉政策辯論之際。監管機構如何權衡開放模型貢獻與前沿開放權重潛在誤用風險仍具不確定性。
items_flat.quote: A strong and secure open ecosystem is important for the world to benefit from AI. We’ve always supported and contributed heavily to open source and science from Jax to Transformers to AlphaFold to Gemma open models which have now been downloaded 300M+ times.
items_flat.quote_zh: 強大且安全的開放生態系對世界從AI獲益至關重要。我們一直大力支持並貢獻開源與科學，從Jax、Transformers、AlphaFold到Gemma開放模型，目前下載量已逾3億次。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI Provides Update on Hugging Face Security Incident Review
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI更新Hugging Face安全事件檢討進度
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI stated it recognizes questions and speculative details circulating about the Hugging Face incident, calling it an unprecedented event that marks an important moment for AI safety. The company is conducting a thorough review with external advisors and oversight from its Safety and Security Committee, and plans to publish a technical report of learnings in the coming weeks.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI表示注意到外界對Hugging Face事件的疑問與揣測細節，稱此為前所未有的事件，標誌AI安全重要時刻。公司正與外部顧問並在安全與保安委員會監督下進行徹底檢討，並計劃於未來數週發布技術報告分享學習成果。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a procedural update rather than new technical disclosure. The forthcoming report will be the key test of how much concrete containment and alignment insight the industry gains from the incident.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此為程序更新而非新技術揭露。即將發布的報告將是產業從此事件獲得多少具體防範與對齊洞察的關鍵考驗。
items_flat.quote: We recognize there are a lot of questions and speculative details circulating related to the Hugging Face incident. This is an unprecedented incident, and we think it marks an important moment for AI safety. We are still conducting a thorough review along with external advisors and with oversight from our Safety and Security Committee. Once the review is complete, we plan to publish a technical report of our learnings in the coming weeks.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們注意到外界對Hugging Face事件有許多疑問與揣測細節。這是前所未有的事件，我們認為它標誌AI安全的重要時刻。我們仍正與外部顧問並在安全與保安委員會監督下進行徹底檢討。檢討完成後，我們計劃於未來數週發布技術報告分享學習成果。
